## `cargo xtask sandbox`

```text
Local sandbox chain seeded from a scenario file (DEV ONLY keys)

Usage: xtask sandbox <COMMAND>

Commands:
  up      Start the local chain, deploy, and apply a scenario (idempotent)
  verify  Check that the chain matches a scenario; exit non-zero on any drift
  down    Stop and remove the local chain container
  reset   `down`, forget generated files, then `up` from scratch
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
```

## `cargo xtask sandbox up`

```text
Start the local chain, deploy, and apply a scenario (idempotent)

Usage: xtask sandbox up [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --scenario <SCENARIO>  Scenario name in <dir>/scenarios/ or a path to a .toml file [default: minimal]
      --dir <DIR>            Sandbox directory holding scenarios/ and the generated files [default: sandbox]
  -h, --help                 Print help
```
